# What check API epoch 2 promises — the check-authoring surface of
# architecture.md §11 as it stood when API_VERSION became 2 (ADR-0051).
#
# Epoch 2 opened by *removing* three names: `parse_subnodes`, `resolve_text` and
# `expand_tokens`. They were how a branch check read and layered its own
# `subnodes:` block; the library reads that block itself now and a type only
# declares its defaults and tokens (ADR-0025), so the helpers
# have no caller outside this repository left to serve. That is exactly the
# decision this mechanism exists to force into the open.
#
# A plugin built for v2 imports these names. tests/test_public_surface.py requires
# the block in §11 to still contain every line here, so a name cannot leave the
# surface without API_VERSION moving — the one check a same-commit rename of both
# the code and the doc cannot quietly satisfy.
#
# This file is APPEND-ONLY within an epoch: adding a name to the surface may add a
# line, removing one is a new epoch and a new file (check_api_v3.txt). Never edit a
# line out of it; a released plugin is still importing that name.
#
# One "<module> <name>" per line.
little_sister.checks API_VERSION
little_sister.checks CHECKS_ASPECT
little_sister.checks CHECK_TYPES
little_sister.checks Check
little_sister.checks CheckError
little_sister.checks CheckResult
little_sister.checks Entry
little_sister.checks checks_dirs
little_sister.checks code
little_sister.checks coerce_code
little_sister.checks config_markdown
little_sister.checks load_checks
little_sister.checks parse_duration
little_sister.checks parse_secret_refs
little_sister.checks plain
little_sister.checks register
little_sister.checks require_api

little_sister.reasons slug
